card.name: The word Avoid starting an instruction
card.fires_on: The word Avoid (or occasionally skip) that opens an instruction right after a condition, patient group, or heading in dosing tables and warnings.

modes.label: Avoid after a heading
modes.description: Avoid begins the instruction line after a condition, population, or severity heading.
modes.example: Pathological hypersecretory conditions<< Avoid>> use b Reduction of the risk of DU

modes.label: Skip a missed dose
modes.description: The word skip opens an instruction after a missed or vomited dose.
modes.example: after taking a dose,<< skip>> the dose and resume AUGTYRO at

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue an avoid-type instruction and away from the word skip itself.
card.plain: It lights up on the word Avoid that begins a do-not-use instruction for a condition or patient group.
